title.en: Hiring out a car: from Sell to your first hirer
title.af: Verhuur 'n motor: van Sell tot jou eerste huurder
title.zu: Ukuqashisa imoto: kusukela ku-Sell kuya kumqashi wakho wokuqala
title.xh: Ukuqeshisa imoto: ukusuka kwi-Sell ukuya kumqeshi wakho wokuqala
title.nso: Go hiriša koloi: go tloga go Sell go ya go mohiri wa gago wa mathomo

en: Tap [[Sell]] and [[Continue with this account]]
In TrustSquare, the Sell button at the bottom opens your seller account.
af: Tik [[Sell]] en [[Continue with this account]]
In TrustSquare maak die Sell-knoppie onder aan jou verkopersrekening oop.
zu: Thepha [[Sell]] bese [[Continue with this account]]
Ku-TrustSquare, inkinobho ethi Sell ngezansi ivula i-akhawunti yakho yokuthengisa.
xh: Cofa [[Sell]] uze [[Continue with this account]]
Kwi-TrustSquare, iqhosha elithi Sell ezantsi livula iakhawunti yakho yokuthengisa.
nso: Kgotla [[Sell]] le [[Continue with this account]]
Go TrustSquare, konopo ya Sell ka tlase e bula akhaonto ya gago ya go rekiša.

en: Pick [[Cars]]
A car for hire is listed under Cars, like a car for sale.
af: Kies [[Cars]]
'n Motor te huur word onder Cars gelys, soos 'n motor te koop.
zu: Khetha [[Cars]]
Imoto eqashwayo ifakwa ngaphansi kwe-Cars, njengemoto edayiswayo.
xh: Khetha [[Cars]]
Imoto eqeshwayo ifakwa phantsi kwe-Cars, njengemoto ethengiswayo.
nso: Kgetha [[Cars]]
Koloi ye e hirišwago e tsenywa ka fase ga Cars, bjalo ka koloi ye e rekišwago.

en: Add your main photo
Front three-quarter. The AI reads it, blurs number plates and fills in what it can see.
af: Voeg jou hooffoto by
Van voor, skuins. Die KI lees dit, maak nommerplate vaag en vul in wat dit kan sien.
zu: Engeza isithombe sakho esikhulu
Ngaphambili, ngasohlangothini. I-AI iyasifunda, ifiphaze amapuleti bese igcwalisa lokho engakubona.
xh: Faka ifoto yakho ephambili
Ngaphambili, ecaleni kancinci. I-AI iyayifunda, ifiphalise iipleyiti ize izalise oko inokukubona.
nso: Tsenya seswantšho sa gago se segolo
Ka pele, ka lehlakoreng. AI e a se bala, e fifatša dipoleiti gomme e tlatša seo e ka se bonago.

en: Choose [[For Hire]]
The first question is "For sale or for hire?". Choose For Hire: the price becomes a rate per day.
af: Kies [[For Hire]]
Die eerste vraag is "For sale or for hire?". Kies For Hire: die prys word 'n tarief per dag.
zu: Khetha [[For Hire]]
Umbuzo wokuqala uthi "For sale or for hire?". Khetha For Hire: intengo iba yinani ngosuku.
xh: Khetha [[For Hire]]
Umbuzo wokuqala uthi "For sale or for hire?". Khetha For Hire: ixabiso liba lixabiso ngosuku.
nso: Kgetha [[For Hire]]
Potšišo ya mathomo ke "For sale or for hire?". Kgetha For Hire: theko e ba tefo ka letšatši.

en: Check the car and type your day rate
Correct make, model, year and colour if the AI got them wrong, then type your rate per day and your area.
af: Kontroleer die motor en tik jou dagtarief
Maak fabrikaat, model, jaar en kleur reg as die KI dit verkeerd het, tik dan jou tarief per dag en jou area.
zu: Hlola imoto bese ubhala inani lakho losuku
Lungisa uhlobo, imodeli, unyaka nombala uma i-AI iphazamile, bese ubhala inani lakho ngosuku nendawo yakho.
xh: Jonga imoto uze ubhale ixabiso lakho losuku
Lungisa uhlobo, imodeli, unyaka nombala ukuba i-AI iphosisile, uze ubhale ixabiso lakho ngosuku nendawo yakho.
nso: Lekola koloi o ngwale tefo ya gago ya letšatši
Lokiša mohuta, modele, ngwaga le mmala ge AI e fošitše, ke moka o ngwale tefo ya gago ka letšatši le lefelo la gago.

en: Write your hire terms
Deposit, shortest hire, free km a day, who may drive, and anything else. They show on your advert.
af: Skryf jou huurvoorwaardes
Deposito, kortste huur, gratis km per dag, wie mag bestuur, en enigiets anders. Dit wys op jou advertensie.
zu: Bhala imigomo yakho yokuqasha
Idiphozi, isikhathi esifushane sokuqasha, ama-km amahhala ngosuku, ongashayela, nokunye. Kuvela esikhangisweni sakho.
xh: Bhala imiqathango yakho yokuqesha
Idiphozithi, elona xesha lifutshane lokuqesha, ii-km zasimahla ngosuku, onokuqhuba, nokunye. Ziyabonakala kwintengiso yakho.
nso: Ngwala melawana ya gago ya go hiriša
Tipositi, nako ye kopana ya go hira, dikhilomithara tša mahala ka letšatši, yo a ka otlelago, le tše dingwe. Di bonagala papatšong ya gago.

en: Gearbox and fuel
Pick manual or automatic and the fuel. Then tap the features the car has.
af: Ratkas en brandstof
Kies handrat of outomaties en die brandstof. Tik dan die kenmerke wat die motor het.
zu: Igiya nophethiloli
Khetha i-manual noma i-automatic nophethiloli. Bese uthepha izici imoto enazo.
xh: Igiya nepetroli
Khetha i-manual okanye i-automatic nepetroli. Emva koko cofa iimpawu imoto enazo.
nso: Giya le makhura
Kgetha manual goba automatic le makhura. Ke moka o kgotle dikarolo tšeo koloi e nago le tšona.

en: Tap [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Your score shows first. Publishing on the free plan costs nothing.
af: Tik [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Jou telling wys eers. Publiseer op die gratis plan kos niks.
zu: Thepha [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Amaphuzu akho avela kuqala. Ukushicilela ohlelweni lwamahhala akukhokhelwa lutho.
xh: Cofa [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Amanqaku akho avela kuqala. Ukupapasha kwisicwangciso sasimahla akuhlawulelwa nto.
nso: Kgotla [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Dintlha tša gago di tšwelela pele. Go phatlalatša ka leano la mahala ga go lefelwe selo.

en: Confirm the car's details
[[You entered]] marks what you typed, [[AI draft]] what the AI read from the photo. Check both against your papers, tap [[Confirm ✓]] on each section and tick the box.
af: Bevestig die motor se besonderhede
[[You entered]] wys wat jy getik het, [[AI draft]] wat die KI van die foto gelees het. Vergelyk albei met jou papiere, tik [[Confirm ✓]] by elke afdeling en merk die blokkie.
zu: Qinisekisa imininingwane yemoto
[[You entered]] ikhombisa okubhalile, [[AI draft]] okufundwe yi-AI esithombeni. Qhathanisa kokubili namaphepha akho, thepha [[Confirm ✓]] esigabeni ngasinye bese umaka ibhokisi.
xh: Qinisekisa iinkcukacha zemoto
[[You entered]] ibonisa oko ukubhalileyo, [[AI draft]] oko i-AI ikufunde kwifoto. Thelekisa zombini namaphepha akho, cofa [[Confirm ✓]] kwicandelo ngalinye uze uphawule ibhokisi.
nso: Netefatša dintlha tša koloi

[[You entered]] e bontšha seo o se ngwadilego, [[AI draft]] seo AI e se badilego seswantšhong. Bapetša ka bobedi le dipampiri tša gago, kgotla [[Confirm ✓]] karolong ye nngwe le ye nngwe o swaye lepokisi.

en: Tap [[Go live]]
Your car is live for hire. Hirers can ask for an introduction straight away.
af: Tik [[Go live]]
Jou motor is regstreeks te huur. Huurders kan dadelik vir 'n voorstelling vra.
zu: Thepha [[Go live]]
Imoto yakho isibukhoma ukuze iqashwe. Abaqashi bangacela ukwethulwa ngokushesha.
xh: Cofa [[Go live]]
Imoto yakho iphilayo ukuze iqeshwe. Abaqeshi banokucela ukwaziswa ngoko nangoko.
nso: Kgotla [[Go live]]
Koloi ya gago e phela go hirišwa. Bahiri ba ka kgopela go tsebišwa gona bjale.

en: A hirer browses [[Cars]] in her city
She opens Browse and taps Cars.
af: 'n Huurder blaai deur [[Cars]] in haar stad
Sy maak Browse oop en tik Cars.
zu: Umqashi ubheka ku-[[Cars]] edolobheni lakhe
Uvula i-Browse bese ethepha u-Cars.
xh: Umqeshi ukhangela kwi-[[Cars]] kwisixeko sakhe
Uvula i-Browse aze acofe u-Cars.
nso: Mohiri o lebelela [[Cars]] toropong ya gagwe
O bula Browse gomme a kgotla Cars.

en: Your car shows its rate per day
The card reads R450 per day, so she knows it is a hire.
af: Jou motor wys sy tarief per dag
Die kaart sê R450 per day, so sy weet dit is te huur.
zu: Imoto yakho ibonisa inani layo ngosuku
Ikhadi lithi R450 per day, ngakho uyazi ukuthi iyaqashwa.
xh: Imoto yakho ibonisa ixabiso layo ngosuku
Ikhadi lithi R450 per day, ngoko uyazi ukuba iyaqeshwa.
nso: Koloi ya gago e bontšha tefo ya yona ka letšatši
Karata e re R450 per day, ka gona o a tseba gore e a hirišwa.

en: She sees [[For hire · hire rate]]
Above the price the advert says it is for hire. Mileage, gearbox and fuel follow.
af: Sy sien [[For hire · hire rate]]
Bo die prys sê die advertensie dit is te huur. Kilometers, ratkas en brandstof volg.
zu: Ubona [[For hire · hire rate]]
Ngaphezu kwentengo isikhangiso sithi iyaqashwa. Amakhilomitha, igiya nophethiloli kuyalandela.
xh: Ubona [[For hire · hire rate]]
Ngaphezu kwexabiso intengiso ithi iyaqeshwa. Iikhilomitha, igiya nepetroli ziyalandela.
nso: O bona [[For hire · hire rate]]
Ka godimo ga theko papatšo e re e a hirišwa. Dikhilomithara, giya le makhura di a latela.

en: She reads your hire terms
Deposit, shortest hire, free km and who may drive, before she asks.
af: Sy lees jou huurvoorwaardes
Deposito, kortste huur, gratis km en wie mag bestuur, voordat sy vra.
zu: Ufunda imigomo yakho yokuqasha
Idiphozi, isikhathi esifushane, ama-km amahhala nongashayela, ngaphambi kokuba acele.
xh: Ufunda imiqathango yakho yokuqesha
Idiphozithi, elona xesha lifutshane, ii-km zasimahla nonokuqhuba, phambi kokuba acele.
nso: O bala melawana ya gago ya go hiriša
Tipositi, nako ye kopana, dikhilomithara tša mahala le yo a ka otlelago, pele a kgopela.

en: She asks for an introduction
She taps [[Join queue]], writes her dates and sends. 1T is held from her and only spent if you accept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n voorstelling
Sy tik [[Join queue]], skryf haar datums en stuur. 1T word van haar teruggehou en net gebruik as jy aanvaar.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Uthepha [[Join queue]], abhale izinsuku zakhe bese ethumela. U-1T uyabanjwa kuye futhi usetshenziswa kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ucofa [[Join queue]], abhale imihla yakhe aze athumele. I-1T iyabanjwa kuye kwaye isetyenziswa kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O kgotla [[Join queue]], a ngwala matšatši a gagwe gomme a romela. 1T e swarwa go yena gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela.

en: The first time, she accepts the terms once
Before her first request she reads the TrustSquare terms and taps [[I accept the Terms]].
af: Die eerste keer aanvaar sy die voorwaardes een keer
Voor haar eerste versoek lees sy die TrustSquare-voorwaardes en tik [[I accept the Terms]].
zu: Okokuqala, wamukela imigomo kanye
Ngaphambi kwesicelo sakhe sokuqala ufunda imigomo ye-TrustSquare bese ethepha [[I accept the Terms]].
xh: Okokuqala, wamkela imigaqo kube kanye
Phambi kwesicelo sakhe sokuqala ufunda imigaqo ye-TrustSquare aze acofe [[I accept the Terms]].
nso: La mathomo, o amogela melawana gatee
Pele ga kgopelo ya gagwe ya mathomo o bala melawana ya TrustSquare gomme a kgotla [[I accept the Terms]].

en: You see her request and her dates
Your Seller Hub shows [[1 request waiting]] with her first name and message.
af: Jy sien haar versoek en haar datums
Jou Seller Hub wys [[1 request waiting]] met haar voornaam en boodskap.
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe nezinsuku zakhe
I-Seller Hub yakho ibonisa [[1 request waiting]] negama lakhe lokuqala nomlayezo.
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe nemihla yakhe
I-Seller Hub yakho ibonisa [[1 request waiting]] negama lakhe lokuqala nomyalezo.
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe le matšatši a gagwe
Seller Hub ya gago e bontšha [[1 request waiting]] le leina la gagwe la pele le molaetša.

en: Tap [[Accept]]
You pay nothing: her 1T is spent now. You both get an email; reply to it to agree the hire. Your email address stays private.
af: Tik [[Accept]]
Jy betaal niks: haar 1T word nou gebruik. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos; antwoord dit om die huur te reël. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Thepha [[Accept]]
Awukhokhi lutho: u-1T wakhe usetshenziswa manje. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili; yiphendule ukuze nivumelane ngokuqasha. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Cofa [[Accept]]
Awuhlawuli nto: i-1T yakhe isetyenziswa ngoku. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile; yiphendule ukuze nivumelane ngokuqesha. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: Kgotla [[Accept]]
Ga o lefe selo: 1T ya gagwe e šomišwa bjale. Ka bobedi le hwetša imeile; e arabe gore le kwane ka go hira. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: She sees it accepted
In My Space, under Intros, her request shows [[Accepted]]. After the hire she can tap [[I hired them]], which adds to your Trust Score.
af: Sy sien dit is aanvaar
In My Space, onder Intros, wys haar versoek [[Accepted]]. Ná die huur kan sy [[I hired them]] tik, wat by jou Trust Score tel.
zu: Ubona ukuthi samukelwe
Ku-My Space, ngaphansi kwe-Intros, isicelo sakhe sibonisa [[Accepted]]. Ngemva kokuqasha angathepha [[I hired them]], okwengeza ku-Trust Score yakho.
xh: Ubona ukuba samkelwe
Kwi-My Space, phantsi kwe-Intros, isicelo sakhe sibonisa [[Accepted]]. Emva kokuqesha angacofa [[I hired them]], nto leyo eyongeza kwi-Trust Score yakho.
nso: O bona gore e amogetšwe
Go My Space, ka fase ga Intros, kgopelo ya gagwe e bontšha [[Accepted]]. Ka morago ga go hira a ka kgotla [[I hired them]], se se oketšago Trust Score ya gago.
